risks.title: Government litigation
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing CPSC/DOJ action concerning reporting violations related to tool bar and miter saw recalls, recommended penalty of approximately 32 million dollars, potential significant direct financial impact.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Strict compliance required with product safety standards and reporting requirements, risks of penalties and operational disruptions.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Highly competitive markets (tools, outdoor products, fastening systems) based on innovation, brand and integrated solutions, requiring continuous investments.

risks.title: Geopolitics and tariffs
risks.score_rationale: Geographic exposure across 18 states and 21 countries, dependence on global supply chains, risks from tariffs and regulatory changes, planning assumptions based on tariff environment of January 2026.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Growing exposure to cybersecurity risks with dependence on digital transformation and global distribution systems.

risks.title: Supply chain
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing supply chain transformation involving portfolio rationalization, reduction of complexity and integration of contract manufacturers, risks of disruption.
